plan.name: Strategy 1: Direct Cooling and Placement
plan.strategy: Prioritize locating the lettuce in the fridge, cool it directly if needed, and place it on the countertop.
steps: Check the fridge to locate the lettuce.
If the lettuce is not already cool, place it in the fridge to cool.
Once cooled, take the lettuce from the fridge.
Place the lettuce on the countertop.
